sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:45

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:45:1
items.html: “I sleep,” corresponding to the last Hey; for in the annulment of the light of the Nekudim, “I sleep”: For the essence of the breaking of the vessels was from the last Hey, and from this the secret of sleep is drawn to her; therefore sleep is intimated in the last Hey.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:45:2
items.html: Hochma is the first Hey etc., and the Nekudot are Hochma. As written above (page 432, the passage beginning “When you count,” and the passage beginning “The letter Yod,” on page 433), the lights that rose as MAN from NHY of AK include all the Nekudot of SAG, which are from Hochma downward, together with ZON of AK. And it is known that a Partzuf is named after its upper Sefira; therefore the Nekudot are called Hochma.
